call_points.text: Management expects to open between 500 to 700 stores in FY27, maintaining the path toward 5,000+ stores by FY29.
Total store network reached 2,579 stores as of March 2026, up from 1,582 stores last year.
Gross margin expanded by 714 bps to 60.28% for FY26, supported by scale benefits and private label mix.
Successfully completed a ₹350 Cr QIP to strengthen the balance sheet and fund expansion.
Marketing spend increased to ₹18 Cr in FY26 from ₹10.5 Cr previously, in line with revenue growth.

operating_notes.text: CRISIL issued final monitoring report for ₹179.07 Cr preferential issue with nil unutilised proceeds as of March 31, 2026.
Appointed actor Akshay Kumar as brand ambassador for the company and UGO Generic.
Board recommended a final dividend of Re. 1/- per equity share (10%) for FY25-26.
Davaindia store count reached 2,579 active stores as of March 2026.
FY26 annual footfalls rose to over 182 lakh customers and GMV reached ₹457.06 Cr.

timeline.summary: CRISIL Ratings issued final monitoring agency report confirming utilization of ₹179.07 Cr preferential issue proceeds.
Zota Health Care appointed actor Akshay Kumar as brand ambassador for the company and its UGO Generic brand on May 19, 2026.
Zota Health Care Limited will host an earnings call on Q4FY26 results on May 25, 2026, at 15:30 hrs (IST) with **Himanshu Zota**, **Moxesh Zota**, and **Dr. Sujit Paul** attending.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹163.18 Cr (+67.8% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹14.17 Cr (against a loss of ₹12.89 Cr a year earlier).
Zota Health Care submitted the statement of deviation or variation under Regulation 32 for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, confirming nil deviation in fund utilization.
Zota Health Care released its FY26 investor presentation highlighting network expansion to 2,579 Davaindia stores and 84% annual revenue growth.
Zota Health Care Limited hosted an earnings conference call on May 25, 2026, discussing Q4 and FY2026 financials, with audio available via the provided link.
Zota Health Care hosted an earnings call discussing FY26 financial results, highlighting network expansion to 2,579 Davaindia stores and positive EBITDA.
HIMANSHU MUKTILAL ZOTA, Promoter & Whole-time Director, declared no new promoter/PAC share encumbrances as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Zota Health Care Limited will host an Earnings Call on Q2FY27 Results on Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 12:00 hrs IST.
